tasks.instruction: Create src/core/IngestionQueue.ts. Import logger from ../utils/logger. Export class IngestionQueue. Define a private queue field as an array of objects with input, output, agent, and optional type string fields. Define a private boolean field processing defaulting to false. Constructor takes worker parameter of type function accepting that event object and returning Promise<void>, stored as a private field. Add method push(event: { input: string; output: string; agent: string; type?: string }): void that appends event to queue and calls this.run() only if processing is false. Add private async method run(): Promise<void> that sets processing to true, loops while queue is non-empty shifting the first item and calling this.worker with it inside a try-catch that logs errors, then sets processing to false.

In src/core/IngestionPipeline.ts, add import of IngestionQueue from ./IngestionQueue. Add a private field queue of type IngestionQueue. At the end of the constructor body, define a workerFn as an async arrow function taking event with input, output, agent, and optional type string fields. Move the entire existing classification logic and repo.save call from ingest into workerFn body, keeping the try-catch. After defining workerFn, assign this.queue = new IngestionQueue(workerFn). Replace the entire body of the ingest method with a single statement: this.queue.push(event).

Create src/core/SearchCache.ts. Import SearchResult and MemoryType from ../core/types/MemoryTypes. Export class SearchCache. Add private field cache as a Map with string keys and values that are objects containing results of type SearchResult array and expiry of type number. Constructor takes ttlMs of type number defaulting to 60000. Add method makeKey(query: string, limit: number, type?: MemoryType): string that returns the three arguments joined with colons, using the string none for undefined type. Add method get(key: string): SearchResult[] or null that returns the cached results if found and Date.now is less than expiry, else deletes the entry and returns null. Add method set(key: string, results: SearchResult[]): void that stores the entry with expiry as Date.now plus this.ttlMs.

In src/core/MemoryMiddleware.ts, add import of SearchCache from ./SearchCache. Add a private field cache of type SearchCache. At the end of the constructor body add this.cache = new SearchCache(). In the enhance method, after computing suggestedType, build a cache key by calling this.cache.makeKey(prompt, limit, suggestedType). Call this.cache.get(cacheKey) and store as cached. If cached is non-null, pass it to this.tokenController.trim and return the injector result immediately without calling repo.search. Otherwise call repo.search as before, then call this.cache.set(cacheKey, results) before passing results to trim and inject.

Create src/core/Metrics.ts. Export class Metrics. Add a private counters field of type Record with string keys and number values, initialized as an empty object. Add method increment(key: string): void that adds 1 to counters[key], initializing it to 0 first if the key is not present. Add method snapshot(): Record<string, number> that returns a shallow copy of counters using Object.assign with an empty object target. After the class definition, export a singleton const metrics equal to new Metrics().

In src/api/memory.routes.ts, add a named import of metrics from ../core/Metrics. In the POST /memory/save handler after the savedEntry is returned successfully, call metrics.increment with the string saves. In the GET /memory/search handler after results are returned successfully, call metrics.increment with the string searches. Add a new route GET /metrics that calls res.status(200).json(metrics.snapshot()) inside a try-catch that logs errors and returns 500.

Create src/core/RetryHelper.ts. Import logger from ../utils/logger. Export async function withRetry with generic type T that takes fn of type function returning Promise<T>, retries of type number defaulting to 3, and delayMs of type number defaulting to 100. Use a for loop from i equal to 0 up to and including retries. Inside the loop body call fn inside a try block and return its result. In the catch block, if i is less than retries log a warning with the retry number and delay using await on a new Promise wrapping setTimeout with delayMs. If i equals retries rethrow the caught error.

In src/embedding/EmbeddingClient.ts, add a named import of withRetry from ../core/RetryHelper. In the embed method, wrap the existing fetch call in withRetry so that the entire fetch expression including url, method, headers, and body is inside an async arrow function passed as the first argument to withRetry, with retries set to 2 and delayMs set to 200. Assign the return value of withRetry to the response variable. Keep all existing code after the response assignment unchanged.
